concept: A gentle dream-tide sanctuary with paired flowing forms, pearl light, and a calm imaginative mood.
floor: One continuous smooth ocean-blue shellstone floor across the full top face, with broad lilac and aqua shading and no water, scales, grass, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One twin-fin-inspired arch at the rear built from two large mirrored aqua ribbon slabs around a luminous lilac pearl opening, abstract rather than animal-like.
rear_props: two oversized pearl star lamps with solid five-lobed forms
two broad flowing blue ribbon sculptures
side_props: three large rounded lilac shellstone forms on the upper-left edge
one broad aqua rest bench and two pearl stones on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded ocean-blue wall with broad aqua and pearl cap blocks
perimeter.emblems: four oversized plain pearl circular insets with no lines or glyphs

lighting: soft dreamlike moon light with two broad pearl lamp glows
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open shellstone floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, fish, fins as animals, animal face, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
wave glyph, Aquarius symbol, repeated wavy lines, pool, open water, scales, zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, bubbles, star specks, tiny shells, cracks, or dense clutter
